names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 19 Φεβρουαρίου, «Άγιοι Μάξιμος, Θεόδοτος, Ησύχιος και Ασκληπιοδότη», with the rank word left off. Beside the gloss the page prints a note that is not about a saint at all: a philosopher of Tyre of the second century after Christ, and a philosopher of the fourth century before.
